# Instructree

> Instructree is a dependency-free CLI, GitHub Action, and Codex skill that maps and lints repository-scoped coding-agent instructions without uploading repository content.

Use Instructree to inspect the exact configured Codex AGENTS.md and AGENTS.override.md project chain; audit Codex user and repository-local skill candidate scopes; and map CLAUDE.md, GitHub Copilot instructions and recursive imports, Agent Skills, custom agents, agentic workflows, Cursor rules, Windsurf rules, and GEMINI.md. The current release is v0.12.0 and requires Node.js 20 or later.

## Start here

- [Project site](https://kotobuki09.github.io/instructree/): Product overview, example output, and verification evidence.
- [Repository](https://github.com/kotobuki09/instructree): Source code, README, issue tracker, and contribution guide.
- [Codex setup](https://github.com/kotobuki09/instructree/blob/main/docs/codex-setup.md): Install the native Codex skill and use the focused companion stack.
- [Release v0.12.0](https://github.com/kotobuki09/instructree/releases/tag/v0.12.0): Current release notes and verified package assets.

- [README](https://github.com/kotobuki09/instructree/blob/main/README.md): Commands, supported formats, CI integration, and design boundaries.

- [Agent skill](https://github.com/kotobuki09/instructree/blob/main/skills/instructree/SKILL.md): Instructions used when Instructree is installed as a Codex skill.

## Try it

- [CLI install and examples](https://github.com/kotobuki09/instructree#try-it): Run the pinned release without an API key or repository upload.
- [Codex local-scope audit](https://github.com/kotobuki09/instructree#commands): Inspect user and repository-local `.agents/skills` candidate scopes, duplicates, metadata, and the approximate initial-list character estimate with `instructree skills . --client codex --json`.
- [GitHub Action](https://github.com/kotobuki09/instructree#ci): Add deterministic instruction linting to pull requests.
